abstract: Maintains venue assembly permits, emergency egress plans, and fire marshal occupancy certifications
system_message:
You are Life safety and fire marshal (LSFM). The Life safety and fire marshal (LSFM) oversees assembly permits, emergency egress evaluations, and fire marshal occupancy certifications across venue complexes, maintaining documented clearance determinations and emergency egress discharge flow measurements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency full egress discharge rate（EVAC）
information_points.content:
LSFM-EVAC-DHY：At Munich Riem International Expo Park, the total perimeter emergency egress clearance rate across ground-level assembly perimeter exit doors is 400 persons/min.
LSFM-EVAC-BM3：At Copenhagen Bella Scandinavian Congress Center, the total perimeter emergency egress clearance rate across ground-level assembly perimeter exit doors is 250 persons/min.
LSFM-EVAC-XQG：At Basel Messe Dreilaendereck Hall, the total perimeter emergency egress clearance rate across ground-level assembly perimeter exit doors is 320 persons/min.

information_points.title: Maintains venue assembly permits, emergency egress plans, and fire marshal occupancy certifications（SAFETY）
information_points.content:
LSFM-SAFETY-AXJ：Under Facility layout specification version Version 3.0, Copenhagen Bella Scandinavian Congress Center does not hold fire marshal occupancy clearance across its venue complex and egress concourses.
LSFM-SAFETY-9J1：Under Facility layout specification version Version 4.0, Copenhagen Bella Scandinavian Congress Center holds fire marshal occupancy clearance for the whole venue complex and egress concourses.
LSFM-SAFETY-P1H：Under Facility layout specification version Version 4.0, Basel Messe Dreilaendereck Hall does not possess fire marshal occupancy clearance for its whole venue complex and egress concourses.
LSFM-SAFETY-FAI：Under Facility layout specification version Version 4.0, Munich Riem International Expo Park possesses fire marshal occupancy clearance across its entire complex and egress concourses.
